flag.description: The flag of Singapore is composed of two equal horizontal bands of red and white. On the hoist side of the red band is a fly-side facing white crescent which partially encloses five small five-pointed white stars arranged in the shape of a pentagon.

descriptions.long: Singapore is a republic that separated from Malaysia in 1965, with English, Malay, Mandarin and Tamil as official languages. The Singapore dollar is the currency, and one of the world's largest container ports, oil refining and finance lead the economy.
descriptions.short: Singapore is an island city-state at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula in Southeast Asia.

flag.description: The flag of Taiwan has a red field. A blue rectangle, bearing a white sun with twelve triangular rays, is superimposed in the canton.

descriptions.long: Taiwan is governed separately from the People's Republic of China, which claims it, and most states hold no formal relations with it. Taipei is its capital, Mandarin is the official language, and semiconductors dominate its export earnings.
descriptions.short: Taiwan is a self-governing island state off the southeastern coast of the Chinese mainland.
